title: The Any exercise picker cannot be reached, so its four journeys can never be tested
what: The only button that opens the Any exercise picker sits in the old Your lifts card, and nothing on the phone shows that card any more. A phone test even lists the card as not on any screen. The four journeys describe a screen no member can open, and the one test only reads the picker's words from its file.
expected: Journeys describe screens a member can reach; a screen nothing opens is marked as such, or removed.
fix_line: Mark these journeys as not reachable, or delete the old picker

title: The month report's error and its stepping between months have no test
what: No test makes the report fail to load, so 'Couldn't load this report' with Try again is never seen. No test steps to the month before or after, so the Next arrow past this month, the empty-month words and the change of title from 'so far' are never checked on a screen.
expected: A test shows the report's error and Try again, and steps back and forward between months, including an empty one.
fix_line: Add a phone test that steps through months and a forced load failure

title: The month picture's body weight rule is tested only with no body weight in the data
what: The month picture tests build the month with an empty body weight list, so they cannot show that body weight is left out when the member has logged it. Only the share sheet's note words are checked.
expected: A test builds a month with body weight logged and checks the picture shows no body weight.
fix_line: Give the month picture test real body weight and check it is absent

title: The routine editor's guards and its failed save are never tested
what: Nothing tests the editor's own rules: an emptied name becoming 'Routine', the '13 sets?' question with 'Keep 13 sets', Start greyed on an empty routine, 'No other folder', the 'Couldn't save your last change' line with Try again, the delete question, and 'Routine not found'. The two known faults where a reorder or rename fails silently sit in this gap.
expected: A test drives the editor through each guard and a forced failed save, and checks the words and that nothing is lost.
fix_line: Add editor tests for each guard and a failed save

title: Supersets, sharing, swapping and use after the free month in the routine editor have no test
what: No test pairs two exercises as a superset or turns it off, shares a routine from the editor, swaps an exercise in a routine (the routine swap is never tested), or checks the editor still works with no Plus.
expected: Each of these editor actions has at least one test that checks the result.
fix_line: Add tests for superset, share, swap and the no-Plus editor

title: The guided first routine is never driven on a phone
what: Only the guide's rules are tested (which step comes next, which button names). No phone test opens the card, walks the four steps and saves, so the saved folder and routine, the 'Leave without saving?' question and the clean-up after a failed save are never seen.
expected: A phone test walks a new member through the guide to a saved routine, and one leaves part way.
fix_line: Add one phone test of the guide, save and leave

title: The routine preview's empty, missing and failed states have no test
what: No test opens the preview of a routine with no exercises, a deleted routine, or one whose read fails, so 'No exercises yet', 'Routine not found' and 'Couldn't load this routine' are never seen. The '(your plan)' label for a trainer's plan and a failed start are not checked either.
expected: A test shows each preview state and the trainer's plan label.
fix_line: Add preview tests for its empty, missing and failed states

title: The saved workout page's failures have no test
what: No test opens a deleted workout, a workout whose read fails, a failed rename, or a workout that cannot be edited, so 'Workout not found', 'Couldn't load this workout', 'Could not rename' and 'Can't edit this one' are never seen. The line saying records will catch up is not checked either.
expected: A test shows each failure state with its words and checks the old name is kept on a failed rename.
fix_line: Add page tests for its failure states

title: The workout summary's failures have no test
what: No test makes the summary read fail after a save, the routine update fail, or Save as routine fail, so 'Summary unavailable', 'Couldn't update the routine...' and the save-failed line are never seen. A member could be told 'Could not save' for a saved workout and no test would notice.
expected: A test forces each failure and checks the words and that the workout stays saved.
fix_line: Add summary tests for each failure

title: No test checks what a finished workout sends off the phone
what: Nothing checks that a workout is copied to MettleUp only for a signed-in member, that workout photos never leave the phone, or that no workout facts go to an AI service when the coach is hidden. Only the 'space is full' status words are tested.
expected: A test finishes a workout signed out and signed in and checks what is queued to leave the phone: nothing, then the workout without photos.
fix_line: Add a finish test that checks what is sent, signed in and out

title: No test double-taps in the routine, workout or summary screens
what: Many journeys here must not add an exercise twice, save two folders, start two workouts, save two workouts or two routines, or open a page twice after a quick double tap. No test taps twice on any of these buttons.
expected: One test per screen taps its main button twice fast and checks only one result.
fix_line: Add double-tap checks to the main buttons
